meta.name: publish
meta.description: Publish oh-my-opencode to npm by triggering the GitHub Actions publish workflow and verifying its artifacts. Ship-only: never runs pre-publish-review or re-reviews merged code unless the user explicitly asks. Argument: <patch|minor|major|explicit-semver>. Triggers: publish, release, deploy, npm publish.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 触发发布流水线,把新版本送上 npm 并逐一核验产物
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次发版都要手动跑工作流、还得检查构建产物是否齐全
copy.tagline_en: Trigger the publish pipeline to ship a new npm version and verify its artifacts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you cut releases by running workflows and checking the built artifacts

howto.what: Claude 会充当发布经理：你给出 patch/minor/major 或具体版本号后，它触发 GitHub Actions 发布工作流并轮询等待，随后验证 npm 包与 GitHub release 等产物，起草发布说明并尝试发到 Discord。
howto.when: 当你提到 publish、release 等关键词，并要求把某个版本发布上线时触发；若没给版本选择符，它会先停下询问。

say.note: 触发发布工作流并轮询到结束
按指定语义化版本触发发布

say.text: 发布说明定稿后把公告发到 Discord
say.note: 发布说明完成后推送 Discord 公告

howto.what_en: Claude acts as release manager: given patch/minor/major or an explicit semver, it runs the GitHub Actions publish workflow, polls it, verifies npm and GitHub release artifacts, drafts notes, and posts to Discord.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to publish/release a version and give a selector such as patch, minor, or major; if no selector is given it stops and asks for one.

say_en.note: Triggers the publish workflow and polls to completion
Triggers a publish for that exact semver

say_en.text: Post the release announcement to Discord
say_en.note: Posts to Discord once notes are final
